title: Fake Flight Change Call
scenario: A caller says your flight changed and asks for your booking code and card security code.

answers.A: Check the flight in the airline app or official website.
answers.B: Read the booking code and card security code to the caller.
answers.C: Give only the booking code so the caller can locate the flight.
answers.D: Hang up and call the airline using its published number.

explanation: A flight change can be checked without surrendering card security data. Use the airline known channel and protect the booking code too.
proTip: The airline can tell you about a flight without asking for a card security code.
